site.name: GEORGIA
site.desc: Two American Hondius passengers transferred to Emory University Hospital SCDU (Serious Communicable Diseases Unit) in Atlanta for monitoring as of 12 May per Axios; two additional Georgia residents from same cruise asymptomatic and following CDC guidance at home. Emory SCDU, established 2002, is one of few US facilities capable of treating dangerous communicable diseases.

site.name: PARIS / LE BOURGET
site.desc: First confirmed hantavirus case in France: one of five repatriated Hondius passengers tested PCR-positive 11 May (Le Monde); condition worsening overnight, strict isolation at Bichat Hospital Paris. French government mandated 42-day quarantine decree with contact tracing identifying 22 potential cases across international flights. The Week confirms French passenger positive post-evacuation from Canary Islands.

site.name: NEBRASKA
site.desc: Nebraska Medicine / UNMC National Quarantine Unit (NQU) received two Americans transported in biocontainment units: one asymptomatic PCR-positive per AP News 11 May, one symptomatic per The Daily Beast. 17 Americans total repatriated via State Dept airlift from Tenerife to Offutt AFB; CDC says widespread US transmission unlikely. Post-assessment, asymptomatic passengers may opt for 42-day home self-monitoring.
